s.zh: 未鉴定：看不出真正的效果。识破卷轴或研究台“鉴定”（需要附魔学）可以看穿。
s.en: Unidentified: its true effects can't be seen. A true seeing scroll or "identify" at a research bench (requires enchantment research) can reveal it.

s.zh: 诅咒已解除：可以正常脱下，效果和代价都还在。
s.en: Curse removed: can be taken off normally; effects and costs remain.

s.zh: 设置里关掉了“诅咒物品”，可以正常脱下。
s.en: "Cursed items" is turned off in settings; can be taken off normally.

s.zh: 穿上后脱不下，只有解除诅咒卷轴能解开。
s.en: Can't be removed once worn; only a remove curse scroll frees it.
is cursed and can't be removed.

s.zh: 识破卷轴的光芒照出了
s.en: The light of the true seeing scroll revealed the true nature of

s.zh: 需要先完成研究“附魔学”。
附近没有可用的研究台或卷轴书桌。
s.en: No usable research bench or scroll desk nearby.

s.zh: 只能由佩戴者本人去鉴定身上的物品。
s.en: Only the wearer can go identify items they're wearing.

s.zh: 让一名研究者把它带到研究台研究2小时（卷轴书桌只要80分钟），看穿它的真面目（需要附魔学）。
s.en: Have a researcher take it to a research bench and study it for 2 hours (only 80 minutes at a scroll desk) to reveal its true nature (requires enchantment).
